collections.title: 230+ creator sponsor & affiliate programs
collections.description: A categorized brand/program directory with application links and creator pitching advice. The author says 177 of 236 entries are affiliate programs rather than guaranteed paid sponsorships; verify each program independently.

collections.title: 100+ short-form video hooks
collections.description: Shorts, TikTok and Reels hook patterns with linked video examples. Pick a structure that fits your real video instead of relying on misleading openings.

collections.title: 297 sound effects for creators
collections.description: Sound effects for short-form and YouTube edits. The external collection is not mirrored: the original-source and redistribution licenses have not been verified.

collections.title: 84 fonts creators use
collections.description: Fonts for thumbnails, subtitles and overlays. The ZIP requires email/newsletter signup, and each font's terms must be reviewed individually.

collections.title: 120 YouTube title templates
collections.description: Fill-in-the-blank title formats with real video examples. Adapt structures to accurate, original ideas instead of copying another creator's claims.

collections.title: 22 subscribe and like animations
collections.description: Light and dark subscribe, like and bell motion assets, supplied as green-screen MP4 and transparent MOV. The author lists a roughly 430 MB ZIP.

collections.title: 234 thumbnails · 25 patterns
collections.description: Study 25 thumbnail layouts using 234 real-world examples. Inspiration for original designs, not permission to copy others' thumbnails.

assets.title: Transition whooshes & impacts
assets.description: Swipe, zoom, whip and impact hits for pacing cuts and highlight reveals.
assets.capcut: Put the sound on an audio track and align its peak with the visual cut.
assets.caveat: Usable within finished content, not as standalone SFX, downloadable source assets or a competing SFX pack.

assets.title: Game-like UI and reward sounds
assets.description: Game win, arcade, click and notification sounds for gaming clips.
assets.capcut: Import individual audio files under moments worth emphasizing.
assets.caveat: Usable within finished content, not as standalone SFX, downloadable source assets or a competing SFX pack.

assets.title: Alternate transition SFX
assets.description: More whooshes, glitches and cinematic stingers when Mixkit's sounds don't fit.
assets.capcut: Download a specific licensed file; import, trim and fade around transitions.
assets.caveat: Check the exact uploader/item and avoid trademarked samples. No standalone redistribution; user-submitted uploads may contain third-party material.

assets.title: Impact, hit and punch pack
assets.description: CC0 impacts for action edits, game highlights and dramatic reveals.
assets.capcut: Convert OGG to MP3/WAV locally if your CapCut version cannot import the original.
assets.caveat: Use the official pack and retain its license evidence if redistributing original binary files. Console/game logos may implicate separate trademark rights.

assets.title: Background beats & production music
assets.description: Instrumental beds and build-up music for montages or narration.
assets.capcut: Import under your speech/game audio and duck its volume; keep the license link.
assets.caveat: Allowed in social/video and online ads; not for games, TV/radio or music-only remixes. YouTube Content ID claims can still require a license dispute.

assets.title: Retro game and digital beeps
assets.description: Short digital stingers, retro game tones and electronic sounds.
assets.capcut: Import the extracted effect (convert OGG if needed) and use sparingly for HUD edits.
assets.caveat: Use the official pack and retain its license evidence if redistributing original binary files. Console/game logos may implicate separate trademark rights.

assets.title: Broad everyday sound effects
assets.description: Ambience, foley, clicks and effects beyond the existing in-repo SFX.
assets.capcut: Use the individual licensed recording in your finished video, not as a standalone download.
assets.caveat: Avoid samples resembling third-party branded effects or music, and inspect rights on the individual asset. Standalone redistribution is prohibited.

assets.title: Find CC0 audio recordings
assets.description: Community field recordings and oddball effects unavailable in conventional libraries.
assets.capcut: Filter licensing to Creative Commons 0 before selecting and keep the individual sound page as evidence.
assets.caveat: Choose sounds explicitly marked CC0; other recordings require attribution or forbid commercial use. User-uploaded material may have unresolved third-party rights.

assets.title: Ready-made video overlays
assets.description: Light leaks, particles and atmospheric effects to layer over gameplay.
assets.capcut: Add above your clip; use blending or chroma-key tools only where they fit the footage.
assets.caveat: Mixkit also lists Restricted License (personal-use) clips and promoted paid content. Only choose the per-clip Free License. No standalone stock redistribution.

assets.title: Video transition footage
assets.description: Ink wipes, motion cuts and clip-to-clip transition elements.
assets.capcut: Import as a clip or overlay around a cut; pick an actual Free License clip.
assets.caveat: Mixkit also lists Restricted License (personal-use) clips and promoted paid content. Only choose the per-clip Free License. No standalone stock redistribution.

assets.title: Film light leaks & flashes
assets.description: Flash frames, film leaks and atmospheric glow for edit accents.
assets.capcut: Add above a clip, trim to a short burst and adjust blending/opacity.
assets.caveat: Mixkit also lists Restricted License (personal-use) clips and promoted paid content. Only choose the per-clip Free License. No standalone stock redistribution.

assets.title: Green-screen overlay footage
assets.description: Chroma-keyable footage for reactions, reveals, screens and effects.
assets.capcut: Place footage above the main edit; remove its green background with chroma key.
assets.caveat: Mixkit also lists Restricted License (personal-use) clips and promoted paid content. Only choose the per-clip Free License. No standalone stock redistribution.

assets.title: Portrait B-roll for Shorts
assets.description: Vertical motion backgrounds and filler shots sized for TikTok, Shorts and Reels.
assets.capcut: Choose 9:16 material; insert between original footage segments.
assets.caveat: Mixkit also lists Restricted License (personal-use) clips and promoted paid content. Only choose the per-clip Free License. No standalone stock redistribution.

assets.title: Real-world vertical B-roll
assets.description: Portrait lifestyle, desk, nature and environment shots for quick context.
assets.capcut: Download footage at the desired resolution and use in the media track.
assets.caveat: Do not resell/redistribute as stock or imply endorsement. Recognizable people, trademarks and depicted artworks may need separate clearances.

assets.title: More chroma-key clips
assets.description: Search animations and compositing clips with green backgrounds.
assets.capcut: Select rights-cleared footage, put above the base track and key out green.
assets.caveat: User uploads are not equally well-cleared; avoid famous characters, copyrighted clips, recognizable logos or commercial products. No standalone stock redistribution.

assets.title: General B-roll footage
assets.description: Real-world cutaways to improve context without overusing gameplay zooms.
assets.capcut: Choose authentic B-roll that supports the narrative, not misleading footage.
assets.caveat: Do not resell/redistribute as stock or imply endorsement. Recognizable people, trademarks and depicted artworks may need separate clearances.

assets.title: Cinematic B-roll alternatives
assets.description: Polished shots for openers, story context and slow-paced montage moments.
assets.capcut: Use free clip downloads in completed edits; do not reuse as a stock library.
assets.caveat: Free for finished projects, not to rehost as a competing stock service; people, property and brands can need separate clearances.

assets.title: CC0 high-resolution textures

assets.title: Seamless CC0 material textures

assets.capcut: Download base-color (albedo) image and import it as a static texture layer.
assets.caveat: Choose base-color/albedo texture JPG or PNG for direct video use; 3D material maps are for 3D applications.
